prerequisites.title: Box developer account
prerequisites.detail: A free Box developer account is enough to start making API calls and testing. Some features, such as Archive APIs, need Enterprise Advanced and are not on the free plan.

prerequisites.title: Admin access in customer enterprise
prerequisites.detail: Production use requires an admin to enable MCP or authorize the app in the Admin Console. Some setup steps also need Admin access.

steps.title: Create a Box app in Developer Console
steps.detail: Open the Developer Console, create an application, configure scopes and generate credentials.
steps.done_when: You have a client ID and client secret.

steps.title: Draft minimal scope list
steps.detail: List only the scopes the agent needs, since scopes set the maximum actions requested.
steps.done_when: A minimal scope list is ready to enter in the app.

steps.title: Create Composio auth config
steps.detail: Create the auth config through Composio's API using your own client ID and secret. Copy the redirect URI from the Composio dashboard and register it in your Box app.
steps.done_when: Auth config exists and the redirect URI is registered in Box.

steps.title: Customer admin enables the integration
steps.detail: The customer's admin enables MCP or authorizes the app in the Admin Console.
steps.done_when: The admin confirms the app is enabled.

steps.title: Connect with Composio managed app
steps.detail: Use the managed Box toolkit to test without registering an app.
steps.done_when: A test connection to your developer account works.

traps.title: Customer admin may block connection
traps.detail: In enterprise accounts, the MCP server or app must be enabled by an admin. Plan outreach to customer admins.

traps.title: Scope changes need re-authorization
traps.detail: When scopes or access level change, the application must be re-authorized for the changes to take effect.

traps.title: API calls count toward customer allocation
traps.detail: Calls from custom apps, including authentication requests, count toward the enterprise's monthly API allocation.

traps.title: Consent screen shows Composio
traps.detail: Without your own OAuth app, the provider consent screen shows Composio's name.

blockers.symptom: Integration cannot be used in a customer's Box enterprise
blockers.what_it_means: The admin has not enabled the MCP server or authorized the app.
blockers.what_to_do: Ask the customer's Box admin to enable it in the Admin Console.
blockers.agent_can_help: Draft instructions for the admin, including the scopes needed.

blockers.symptom: API calls return 404 Not found in a tutorial setup
blockers.what_it_means: The service account has not been shared on the target folder.
blockers.what_to_do: Invite the service account email as an Editor collaborator on the folder.

evidence.question: G4
